I am unsettled by the change in moderator staff, but not knowing any of the individuals involved personally, cannot assess off the cuff whether this is for better or worse. Any internal conflict in a group so small and besieged is dangerous, but bad leadership can be even worse. So, as a man of science, here are the metrics I will use to examine the state of v/identitarian:

I will examine the modlog and see what it is that they choose to remove. I am glad to see degenerate pornography removed. I would be less pleased to see honest argument removed. If honest discussion of race is censored, if the language or iconography of the far right is censored, that will to me be proof that the sub has been seized by the opposition.

I will examine what sort of content is posted in this sub, compared to related subs such as v/European and v/niggers. I do not expect all the same things to be in every place; building up the white race need not involve spitting on the rest, but it does require honesty and truth regarding racial issues. Similarly, if none of those who take the effort to post quality content care to participate, that is a powerful statement about the quality of the sub as well.

I will examine how the new staff conduct themselves, and whether their speech and actions are in accordance with the ideology they claim to uphold. It has been alleged by one of the removed mods that the changeover in staff represents an Identity Evropa takeover of the sub. If that is the case, or if IE is involved but in some other fashion, I would hope to see them speak openly and plainly regarding their allegiance and intent. IE do not represent every race realist but they have demonstrated a measure of legitimacy and willingness to take real steps in person to advance the interests of the white race. There should be no need for silence on this matter.

Acknowledging that my nation has been damaged and lessened through mongrelization and the importation of less competitive races was hard. But, colorblindness was predicated on lies and propaganda, counter-indicated by science. So here I am. I will continue to search for truth, in that matter and in this matter.

I would like to hear from others how they plan to assess the merit of v/identitarian going forward.
